answer.conclusion: UIDAI's current public My Aadhaar page displays a ₹75 fee for Address update. This confirms the existing ₹75 claim for scenario_aadhaar_address_update_online_poa.
answer.centreComparison: UIDAI's current Aadhaar Enrolment and Update Charges sheet classifies address as a demographic update. At an Aadhaar centre, a demographic update done separately costs ₹75; if done at the same time as a biometric update, the demographic-update component is free.
answer.routeSeparation: The charge sheet lists Document update as a separate service: submission of PoI and PoA documents in support of details already enrolled. Its myAadhaar fee waiver through 14.06.2027 is not the fee for changing an address. Head-of-Family is also a separate address-update method and is not used as evidence for the primary own-PoA scenario.
